risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says PSR-175 and '275', but photo panel appears to be PSR-73). Wrong model affects value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (usually on the back or underside) and a photo of the exact model printed near the panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-matching Yamaha used keyboard comparable (worst case: treat as PSR-73/entry model rather than higher model).

risks.risk: No proof the keyboard is actually working (keys, speakers, display, power, and sound).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on + screen lit + play a few keys + show volume/speaker output (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: assume issues until tested).

risks.risk: Missing/unknown accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, etc.) can reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything included laid out (adapter, cables, pedal/stand if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (worst case: no adapter/pedal/stand).

risks.risk: Potential physical damage not visible in one front photo (cracked casing, missing knobs, damaged keys).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of: both speaker grilles, all knobs/buttons, and a straight-on shot of the full keybed (including ends).
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition (worst case: assume minor wear and possible cosmetic issues).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (back/underside) showing the exact model number.
Short video proof: power on, display working, play keys, and audible sound through speakers (or headphone jack).
Photo of included accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand/any cables).
Close-ups of knobs/buttons and both ends of the keybed (to check for missing/damaged parts).
response.reason: The seller’s model claims conflict with what the photo appears to show, and there is no functional test proof (sound/keys/power). Without confirming the exact model and working status, a safe price cannot be set.
